news.body: After last week's 18% share price gain to ₹16.66, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 44.3x. Average trailing P/E is 24x in the Electrical industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 3.5% over the past three years.

news.title: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited Announces Board and Committee Changes, Effective February 3, 2026
news.body: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited announced that Mr. Deepak Kumar (Non-Executive Non-Independent Director) has been re-designated as Chairperson of the Company in place of Krishnakumar Laxman Bangera (Non-Executive Independent Director), who has ceased to be a Director of the Company. The Board of Directors, based on recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, appointed Mr. Deepak Kumar as Chairperson of the Company in place of Krishnakumar Laxman Bangera, who has ceased to be a Director. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.11 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (down from ₹0.11 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹43.1m (down 77% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.37m (down 68% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 19% (up from 14% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 36% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
